description.value: Vasanti Estate Winery is a family-owned estate winery on the northern edge of Oliver opened in June 2024 by the Sidhu family, who have farmed the South Okanagan for over 40 years. The winery offers guided tastings of small-lot, award-winning wines paired with locally inspired small plates and cocktails served on a patio overlooking the estate vineyards. Sitting directly on Highway 97 in the heart of Okanagan wine country, it is a natural stop on the classic Oliver–Osoyoos cycling corridor.
